description: Uploads the document Apple asks for with an encryption declaration, from an absolute path on this machine (PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB): the CCATS from the US Bureau of Industry and Security (proprietary algorithms) and/or the French encryption declaration (on the App Store in France). Only a document the person gave you: they come from those authorities, never write one. Apple takes one file per declaration, so two documents go in one PDF. Kept in Ploa and sent with the declaration.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_encryption_document
title: Upload the export compliance document
